kind: Independent review of initial durable journal; amendment required
finding: Closing the journal's separately opened raw database FD can cancel another same-process journal instance's active SQLite POSIX locks

reproduction.environment: Actual macOS local filesystem, CPython project venv, SQLite3.53.4
reproduction.setup: Two DurableExecutionJournal objects on one private temporary root; first retains BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction while a subprocess probes SQLite SHAREDFIRST byte1073741826
reproduction.recording_qualification: These observations transcribe the actual tool output; this is not a claim that a separate raw command-log file was captured

required_amendments: Remove persistent raw database FD opening/closing while SQLite connections can exist; retain private-path and inode checks without bypassing SQLite's lock-aware descriptor lifecycle
Prevent live same-root journal instances from selecting different SQLite modules/C libraries in one process
Reset any new global driver-registry mutex/state safely in fork children without touching parent lock authority
Add actual concurrent journal-close OS-lock regression and driver-mixing/fork tests; preserve original93-case acceptance as historical
other_review_observations: Per-job flock and inode binding conservatively prevent a competing holder from claiming live effect scope
Reacquisition remains reconciliation-required, not automatic execution, termination or release authority
Private root, schema/chain readback, bounded SQL projections and transactional result/finish recording are explicit
The real orchestrator must hold the lease throughout physical effects and must not treat a returned snapshot as permanent authority
review_state: Blocked pending source amendment and focused verification
